simp.text: 在墙角底下有一个小小的洞。

trad.text: 在牆角底下有一個小小的洞。
trad.bpmf: 在牆角底下有一󠇡個󠇡小小的洞。

example.en: At the foot of the wall there was a tiny little hole.

simp.text: 洞里住著老鼠爸爸、老鼠妈妈，还有他们的女儿。

trad.text: 洞裡住著老鼠爸爸、老鼠媽媽，還有他們的女兒。
trad.bpmf: 洞裡住著老鼠爸爸󠇡、老鼠媽媽，還有他們的女兒。

example.en: Inside the hole lived Papa Mouse, Mama Mouse, and their daughter.

simp.text: 第一个想到的就是太阳。

trad.text: 第一個想到的就是太陽。
trad.bpmf: 第一個󠇡想到的就是太陽。

example.en: The first thing he thought of was the sun.

simp.text: 爸爸点点头，赶紧又去找风。

trad.text: 爸爸點點頭，趕緊又去找風。
trad.bpmf: 爸爸󠇡點點頭，趕緊又去找風。

example.en: Papa nodded and hurried off to look for the wind.
Papa had no choice but to go looking for the wall.

simp.text: 角落堆著几颗圆鼓鼓的花生。

trad.text: 角落堆著幾顆圓鼓鼓的花生。
trad.bpmf: 角落堆著幾顆圓鼓鼓的花生。

example.en: In the corner sat a little pile of plump round peanuts.

simp.text: 还有一小团棉花当作软软的床。

trad.text: 還有一小團棉花當作軟軟的床。
trad.bpmf: 還有一󠇢小團棉花當作軟軟的床。

example.en: There was also a small puff of cotton for a soft bed.

simp.text: 这只小老鼠一天一天长大，尾巴变长了。

trad.text: 這隻小老鼠一天一天長大，尾巴變長了。
trad.bpmf: 這隻小老鼠一󠇢天一󠇢天長󠇡大，尾巴變長了。

example.en: The little mouse grew day by day, and her tail grew longer.
Her whiskers turned shiny too.

simp.text: 都会帮妈妈把米粒一颗一颗排好。

trad.text: 都會幫媽媽把米粒一顆一顆排好。
trad.bpmf: 都會幫媽媽把米粒一󠇢顆一󠇢顆排好。

example.en: She would help Mama line up the grains of rice one by one.

simp.text: 爬上村子里最高的屋顶。

trad.text: 爬上村子裡最高的屋頂。
trad.bpmf: 爬上村子󠇡裡最高的屋頂。

example.en: He climbed to the highest roof in the village.

simp.text: 觉得有道理，就去找乌云。

trad.text: 覺得有道理，就去找烏雲。
trad.bpmf: 覺得󠇡有道理，就去找烏雲。

example.en: It made sense to him, so he went to look for the dark cloud.
Your teeth are sharp and pointy.
A sheet of red paper was hung over the doorway of the hole.

simp.text: 老鼠一家热热闹闹地办起了婚礼。

trad.text: 老鼠一家熱熱鬧鬧地辦起了婚禮。
trad.bpmf: 老鼠一󠇢家熱熱鬧鬧地󠇡辦起了婚禮。

example.en: The mouse family held a lively, bustling wedding.

vocab.en: to marry, said of a woman leaving her family for her husband's. 嫁女兒 is to marry a daughter off, which is what the whole story is about

simp.text: 一定要嫁给世界上最厉害的人。

trad.text: 一定要嫁給世界上最厲害的人。
trad.bpmf: 一󠇡定要嫁給世界上最厲害的人。

example.en: She must marry the mightiest person in the whole world.

simp.text: 可是呀，我并不是最厉害的。

trad.text: 可是呀，我並不是最厲害的。
trad.bpmf: 可是呀󠇡，我並不󠇡是最厲害的。

example.en: But you see, I am not the mightiest one.

vocab.en: ability, skill, what someone is capable of

example.en: Your ability is the greatest.

simp.text: 因为女儿已经到了可以结婚的年纪啦。

trad.text: 因為女兒已經到了可以結婚的年紀啦。
trad.bpmf: 因為󠇡女兒已經到了可以結婚的年紀啦。

example.en: Because their daughter had reached the age when she could marry.

simp.text: 我们要找一个本事最大、最了不起的女婿。

trad.text: 我們要找一個本事最大、最了不起的女婿。
trad.bpmf: 我們要找一󠇡個󠇡本事最大、最了󠇡不起的女婿。

example.en: We want to find the most capable, most remarkable son-in-law.
Deep down she felt a little nervous.

simp.text: 只是很害羞，一直不敢说出来。

trad.text: 只是很害羞，一直不敢說出來。
trad.bpmf: 只是很害羞，一󠇢直不敢說出來。

example.en: She was just too shy, and never dared to say it out loud.

vocab.en: to discuss, to talk something over

simp.text: 爸爸妈妈小小声地讨论。

trad.text: 爸爸媽媽小小聲地討論。
trad.bpmf: 爸爸󠇡媽媽小小聲地󠇡討論。

example.en: Papa and Mama talked it over in small quiet voices.

simp.text: 爸爸仰著头，很有礼貌地喊。

trad.text: 爸爸仰著頭，很有禮貌地喊。
trad.bpmf: 爸爸󠇡仰著頭，很有禮貌地󠇡喊。

example.en: Papa tilted his head up and called out very politely.
He is very strong, and hardworking as well.

simp.text: 你这么坚固，连风都挡得住。

trad.text: 你這麼堅固，連風都擋得住。
trad.bpmf: 你這麼堅固，連風都擋得󠇡住。

example.en: You are so sturdy that you can even block the wind.
The wall stayed silent for a good while.
He came running to the mouse family to propose marriage.

vocab.en: reluctant to part with someone or something you love

example.en: Yet they felt a little reluctant to let her go.

vocab.en: cannot help doing something, unable to hold it back

simp.text: 这下子却忍不住笑了出来。

trad.text: 這下子卻忍不住笑了出來。
trad.bpmf: 這下子󠇡卻忍不󠇡住笑了出來。

example.en: This time he could not help laughing out loud.
